title: Best 10 Authoring Tools for Technical Writers | The Content Writing Craft
summary: On April 1 2026, The Content Writing Craft published a roundup of the ten best authoring tools for technical writers in 2025. summary: The article outlines how to select XML authoring tools, highlighting Heretto’s DITA‑based features for content reuse, version control, and release management. title: What is DITA XML? | An Easy Introduction
summary: An article introduces DITA XML as a technology for structured authoring, reuse, and translation. It matters to documentation teams because DITA supports modular content, simplifies localization, and improves efficiency in creating and maintaining user guides and e‑learning materials.

summary: A tutorial introduced a Docs-as-Code workflow using GitLab CI/CD, VS Code, and markdown/reStructuredText to build and publish documentation. title: Are you ready to move from static to dynamic documentation?
summary: The article examines the shift from static site‑generator based documentation to managed dynamic documentation services, highlighting skill‑level and tooling challenges for teams. title: Static site generators
summary: The article reviews static site generators, highlighting Jekyll’s developer‑focused docs and the steep technical knowledge required to use them. It warns documentation teams that choosing a generator with clearer, less technical guidance is crucial for broader audience adoption.
